ceiling_directive: Prove the global context-factor dichotomy: exhaustive provenance-carrying recovery must either assemble a total observed-cell formula or produce jointly positive, quotient-shared countermodels from the surviving partial-trace forests.
improvement_directive: Complete oeq:global-context-factor-dichotomy by proving that residual multi-block forests yield a jointly positive shared-row kernel direction with zero full observed increment and nonzero query increment, and prove the converse that absence of such a direction forces total arithmetic recovery.
critique: The advertised complete state-specific identification procedure is not delivered: the theorem that would make the finite search exhaustive and complete is explicitly left open. The binary-sink results prove only that an already accepted row-space certificate is sound; they do not show that every unidentified query in that slice produces such a certificate, so the TL;DR's description of a "settled" base case is stronger than the proved completeness content. The root-control bridge transfers formulas only when the published per-context criterion succeeds and expressly supplies no nonidentification converse on the note's model class. The two rational examples validate boundary behavior but do not establish a general forest-to-obstruction characterization. What remains is therefore mainly verifier infrastructure, elementary affine-nullspace machinery, and comparator compilation, while the load-bearing identification dichotomy required for a field-level contribution is deferred.
